correctness.rationale: Reconstructed spectral layer cake for 0<=A<=I (positive contractions): A=integral_0^1 1_{A>=t}dt; convexity reduces to projections; in dimension 3 T(I)=0 changes rank-two to negative rank-one. Diagonal gauge reduces v to nonnegative magnitudes x,y,z summing to one. The nonzero triangular block [[sqrt(xy),0],[sqrt(xz),sqrt(yz)]] has characteristic polynomial lambda^2-[y(1-y)+xz]lambda+xz*y^2. For y<1/2 the top lambda increases with xz (max x=z), for y>1/2 it decreases (max boundary <=1/4), and at y=1/2 top lambda=1/4. On x=z=t, 1/4<=t<=1/2, norm g(t)=[t+sqrt(4t-7t^2)]/2 maximizes uniquely at t=(4+sqrt2)/14, g=(1+2sqrt2)/7. Checked the rank-one attaining projection, endpoints y=0,1, rank-zero and full-rank projections. Independent numerical recomputation of this 1-variable optimum agreed to machine precision; finite tests only corroborate the exact proof.
